proposed_action.draft_text:
Reminder on reviewer notes for the bilingual alignment check:
- Newly assigned multi_pilot_17 tasks: record a reviewer note only when the two lines disagree.
- Archived multi_batch_09 exports keep the old always-note format.
- Check the batch code in the task metadata or export header before deciding.
- If you still see an older help page saying everyone should use the note, follow the Multilingual alignment review guide v2.0, section Reviewer notes.
If the batch code is unclear, reply in your thread.

proposed_action.draft_text:
Reminder on reviewer notes for the bilingual alignment check:
- Newly assigned multi_pilot_17 tasks: record a reviewer note only when the two lines disagree.
- Archived multi_batch_09 exports keep the old always-note format.
- Check the batch code in the task metadata or export header before deciding.
- If you still see an older help page saying everyone should use the note, follow the Multilingual alignment review guide v2.0, section Reviewer notes.
If the batch code is unclear, reply in your thread.
